subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_____careful - that clock is very old.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Be'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Be**" is the imperative form of the verb "**to be**."
 
• The imperative form is used to give commands or instructions.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Be careful - that clock is very old."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Been"** is incorrect because "been" is the past participle of "be" and cannot be used in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "Being"** is incorrect because "being" is the present participle of "be" and cannot be used in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "I"** is incorrect because it does not fit grammatically in the sentence structure.
